hooks.command: { ! [ -d backend ] || (cd backend && uv run ruff check . && uv run pytest); } && { ! [ -d frontend ] || (cd frontend && npm run lint && npm run test); }

COMMAND=$(python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('tool_input',{}).get('command',''))" 2>/dev/null || echo ''); if echo "$COMMAND" | grep -qiE 'rm\s+-rf|git\s+push\s+--force|git\s+push\s+--force-with-lease|git\s+reset\s+--hard|git\s+clean\s+-f|DROP\s+TABLE|DROP\s+DATABASE|DROP\s+SCHEMA|TRUNCATE\s+TABLE|DELETE\s+FROM'; then echo 'BLOCKED: 위험한 명령어가 감지되었습니다.' >&2; exit 2; fi
